items.label: Tablet, Drawing Pad, Digital Notebook & Musician Tablet – All in One
items.value: From creative minds to busy professionals, musicians, and avid streamers, the TCL NXTPAPER 14 fits seamlessly into any lifestyle. Equipped with a 14.3-inch 2.4K display that delivers rich, lifelike colors and a 4096-pressure-level T-PEN stylus for fluid, accurate input, it’s perfectly suited for drawing, note-taking, reading, viewing digital sheet music, and multimedia entertainment

items.label: Effortless Eye Comfort on a Paper-Like Screen
items.value: Powered by NXTPAPER 3.0 display technology, the TCL NXTPAPER 14 delivers a paper-like viewing experience with an anti-glare coating, blue light reduction, and DC dimming—engineered to reduce eye strain during long hours of use. The Eye Care Assistant automatically adjusts screen brightness and color temperature to match your surroundings and prompts you to take regular breaks

items.label: Seamless 3-in-1 Display Modes with NXTPAPER Key
items.value: Instantly switch between modes with the dedicated NXTPAPER Key on the TCL NXTPAPER 14 tablet. Regular Mode offers vibrant visuals for movies and video calls. Ink Paper Mode recreates the texture of e-paper for long reading, note-taking, and sheet music display. Color Paper Mode delivers soft, low-saturation tones that are perfect for digital art, comics, and creative projects

items.label: Strong Performance for Multitasking & Multi-Window Productivity
items.value: Driven by the MediaTek Helio G99 processor and running Android 14, TCL electronics tablets combine 256GB of storage with 8GB RAM, plus an additional 8GB of expandable memory, handling study, work, and creative apps with ease. TCL’s smart UI boosts productivity by supporting screen mirroring, extended displays, floating windows, and split screen. Note: Built-in storage only; microSD cards not supported

items.label: 10,000mAh Powerhouse with Fast & Reverse Charging
items.value: Power through your day with the TCL NXTPAPER 14 Android tablet’s massive 10,000mAh battery—fully recharged in about two hours with 33W fast charging. Whether you’re working, studying, or creating on the go, it keeps up effortlessly. Additionally, reverse charging lets you power your phone or earbuds anytime, anywhere. Note: Charger not included

items.label: Immersive Multimedia with Sharp Video & Rich Audio
items.value: The TCL NXTPAPER 14 tablets feature dual front cameras (13MP + 5MP) and an 8MP rear autofocus camera, all supporting 2K video for clear, detailed visuals in video calls, online teaching, or vlogging. The quad stereo speaker system with Smart PA delivers rich, room-filling sound — up to 200% volume — for an experience you’ll feel as much as hear

items.label: Slim Yet Strong – Elegant Design with Everyday Durability
items.value: Crafted at just 0.27 inches thin and weighing 1.67 lbs, the TCL NXTPAPER 14 drawing tablet combines a generous display with refined portability, offering the perfect harmony of style, size, and usability. The durable metal build handles everyday bumps with ease, while the included adjustable flip case keeps it protected and instantly becomes a stand for hands-free use anywhere

items.label: Built-in Media
items.value: Flip Case, T-PEN Stylus, TCL NXTPAPER 14 Tablet, USB-C Cable
